Accessors for IsoformicExperiment Objects

Source: R/IsoformicExperiment-methods.R
IsoformicExperiment-accessors.Rd

S7 generics giving SummarizedExperiment-style access to the three levels of an IsoformicExperiment. All of them return in-memory tibbles or matrices; the annotation tables are read from Parquet on first use and cached (see the class documentation).

Samples

  • col_data(), col_data<-: sample metadata (sample_id first).

  • col_names(): sample IDs of the assays.

Transcript level

  • assays(), assay(x, name), assay_names(), assay<-: transcript matrices. assay() without a name returns the first assay.

  • row_names(): transcript IDs of the assays.

  • row_data(): transcript annotation (with gene columns) for the assayed transcripts, in assay row order.

  • tx_annot(): the same join for all annotated transcripts.

  • tx_to_gene(): two-column transcript/gene mapping.

Gene level

  • gene_assays(), gene_assay(x, name), gene_assays<-: gene matrices, derived by summing isoforms unless set explicitly.

  • gene_data(): gene annotation for the genes represented in the assays.

  • gene_names(): gene IDs of the gene assays.

Annotation

  • annot_data_transcripts(), annot_data_genes(), annot_data_exons(): the raw annotation tables.

  • annot_data(): transcript-centric join of transcripts and genes (exons optional).

  • annot_metadata(): named list describing the annotation source.

  • exon_table(x, gene_name): exons of the transcripts of selected genes.

Housekeeping

  • clear_cache(): drop cached derived data for the object (and, with annotation = TRUE, the shared annotation tables).

Usage

col_data(self, ...)

col_data(self) <- value

col_names(self, ...)

assays(self, ...)

assay_names(self, ...)

assay(self, name = NULL, ...)

assay(self, name) <- value

row_names(self, ...)

row_data(self, ...)

tx_annot(self, ...)

tx_to_gene(self, ...)

gene_assays(self, ...)

gene_assays(self) <- value

gene_assay(self, name = NULL, ...)

gene_names(self, ...)

gene_data(self, ...)

annot_data_transcripts(self, ...)

annot_data_genes(self, ...)

annot_data_exons(self, ...)

annot_data(self, with_exons = FALSE, ...)

annot_metadata(self, ...)

exon_table(self, gene_name, ...)

clear_cache(self, annotation = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

self

An IsoformicExperiment.

...

Passed on to methods.

value

Replacement value.

name

Name of the assay. NULL selects the first assay.

with_exons

Logical, also join the exon table (one row per exon).

gene_name

Character vector of gene names or gene IDs.

annotation

Logical, also clear the shared annotation cache.

Value

See the individual descriptions above.

Examples

iso <- example_isoformic()
